_about: Adam's Logos purchase 'Classic Commentaries and Studies on Revelation Upgrade (32 vols)', its titles as listed on logos.com read 2026-11-03, each found as a pre-1931 Internet Archive scan and its title page read (where only the catalogue was read, the row says so). One shelf for the bundle because its authors mostly have one book each; works already on another shelf are not repeated (listed under _excluded). Internet Archive OCR, raw; the 1600s and 1700s scans (EEBO and ECCO) carry heavy OCR noise. All pre-1931, so US public domain. Added 2026-11-03 by lane A. No uids minted.

ccr-holland-epitome: An Exposition, or a Short, but Full, Plaine, and Perfect Epitome of the Most Choice Commentaries upon the Revelation of Saint John, by Hezekiah Holland (London, 1650; EEBO scan)
ccr-knollys-revelation: An Exposition of the Whole Book of the Revelation, by Hanserd Knollys (London, 1689; EEBO scan)
ccr-daubuz-perpetual: A Perpetual Commentary on the Revelation of St. John, by Charles Daubuz (London, 1720; ECCO scan)
ccr-desprez-daniel-john: Daniel and John: or, The Apocalypse of the Old and That of the New Testament, introduction by Rowland Williams, by Philip S. Desprez (London: C. Kegan Paul, 1878)
ccr-maitland-enquiry: An Enquiry into the Grounds on Which the Prophetic Period of Daniel and St. John Has Been Supposed to Consist of 1260 Years, by S. R. Maitland (London: Hatchard; Gloucester: Hough, 1826)
ccr-cuninghame-seals-trumpets: A Dissertation on the Seals and Trumpets of the Apocalypse, and the Prophetical Period of Twelve Hundred and Sixty Years, 3rd ed. corrected and enlarged, by William Cuninghame (London: Thomas Cadell, Hatchard, and James Nisbet, 1832)
ccr-milligan-apocalypse: Lectures on the Apocalypse: The Baird Lecture, 1885, by William Milligan (London: Macmillan, 1892)
ccr-hayden-ten-lectures: The Apocalyptic Dispensation: Ten Lectures on the Book of Revelation, by William B. Hayden (Boston: T. H. Carter, 1865)
ccr-reid-lectures: Lectures on the Revelation, by William J. Reid (Pittsburgh: Stevenson, Foster, 1878)
ccr-wells-twenty-four: Twenty-Four Lectures on the Book of Revelation, by James Wells (London: E. Banks, 1870)
ccr-douglass-four-lectures: Four Short Lectures on the Book of the Revelation, by Benjamin Douglass (Chicago, 1886)
ccr-hsl-studies: Studies on the Apocalypse; or, An Attempt to Elucidate the Revelation of St. John, by H. S. L. (London: Hatchard; catalogue date 1838)
ccr-benson-apocalypse: The Apocalypse: An Introductory Study of the Revelation of St John the Divine, by Edward White Benson (London: Macmillan, 1900)
ccr-woodhouse-apocalypse: The Apocalypse, or Revelation of Saint John, Translated, with Notes Critical and Explanatory, by John Chappel Woodhouse (London: J. Hatchard; catalogue date 1805)
ccr-milner-seven-churches: History of the Seven Churches of Asia: Their Rise, Progress, and Decline, by Thomas Milner (London; catalogue date 1832)
ccr-todd-antichrist: Six Discourses on the Prophecies relating to Antichrist in the Apocalypse of St. John, by James Henthorn Todd (catalogue: Dublin: University Press, 1846)
